newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat, new issues rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat, new issues rise.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed flat on Thursday after a day of slow trading as buying by banks and securities was balanced by selling pressure stemming from heavy new issues, brokers said.
The three-month CDs also remained unchanged. Rising money demand for wage and tax payments kept the overnight call rates from falling, brokers said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.38 unchanged from Wednesday
* Overnight call average 12.30 pct, flat from Wednesday
The overnight call rate remained high at 12.30 percent as short-term money demand began rising, brokers said.
Money demand tends to rise towards the end of the month because of salary and tax payments.
